envelope.command: read-only GitHub repository, branch, release, asset, redirect, and pull-request verification; fresh installed Release-wheel Engine and Validation pytest; artifact_store.py normalize/check/resolve; local Git topology and cleanup audit

failed_outcomes.name: initial_release_replay_environment
failed_outcomes.observed: Initial disposable environment omitted the test-only NumPy dependency and stopped during collection; after installing the repository-declared test dependency, the unchanged Release wheel passed the full suite.

user_approval.source: explicit Codex task request on 2026-08-04 to begin the full ePC-SAFT package cutoff with Lithium and MEA deferred

observations.expected: Repository R_kgDOTZ9m0Q is named ePC-SAFT/ePC-SAFT-engine and the former EOS Git endpoint redirects to the same protected main.
observations.observed: The new and former Git endpoints both resolved protected main at 8f621e1a9e42412887cb8adebfda13e03ff66d36; the accepted runtime source remains c712fe9730faef0732341ccdabc4d799fef2d953.

observations.name: release_asset_identity
observations.expected: Prerelease v0.2.0.dev0 targets the accepted Engine source and contains exactly the accepted wheel bytes.
observations.observed: Release 365229324 targets c712fe9730faef0732341ccdabc4d799fef2d953; asset 501989205 is 4577089 bytes with GitHub and downloaded SHA-256 21ed202df4aa5f8a516aa6400a3a09fe9b5e1d267935f6c5411b92e8faf9d049.

observations.name: fresh_installed_wheel_replay
observations.expected: All public modules originate from one non-editable installed Release wheel and retained Engine and Validation suites pass.
observations.observed: One epcsaft distribution supplied epcsaft, epcsaft.equilibrium, and epcsaft.regression from site-packages; Engine passed 305 tests with 22 campaigns deselected in 146.50 seconds and Validation passed 5 tests in 0.35 seconds.

observations.expected: Equilibrium and Regression are archived at their accepted protected main commits with no open pull requests.
observations.observed: R_kgDOTZ9n6A is archived at 64446f06d26b8bd7c3437d465d149fc5320c6776 and R_kgDOTZ9ogA is archived at 0eff43a172ed6c913b281bf78f00100e7338c813; both main branches remain protected.

observations.name: single_artifact_authority
observations.expected: The active channel contains one Engine wheel and retired distributions fail closed.
observations.observed: Active alias and object indexes contain only epcsaft at 21ed202df4aa5f8a516aa6400a3a09fe9b5e1d267935f6c5411b92e8faf9d049; artifact_store.py check and epcsaft resolution pass, while both retired distribution names return distribution is not active.

observations.name: local_topology_and_cleanup
observations.expected: The active checkout is named Engine with its canonical remote; active repositories are clean on synchronized main; obsolete package environments and candidate wheels are absent.
observations.observed: Engine, Data, Validation, Lab, and the organization profile are clean on synchronized main; Engine uses https://github.com/ePC-SAFT/ePC-SAFT-engine.git; the retired local package checkouts were verified clean on synchronized main and then moved to Trash; four package environments, the candidate review wheel, the release-download copy, the verification environment, three former aliases, and seventeen loose legacy wheel objects were also moved to Trash.

observations.name: deferred_consumer_scope
observations.expected: Lithium Extraction and both MEA repositories remain quarantined, non-admitted, and untouched by this cutoff.
observations.observed: D-024 was authorized at 2026-08-04T18:52:38-06:00 and keeps all three applications outside package authority. This authority phase performed no downstream write. Earlier attempted migration commits 33f619af7aeea21b5a640ad5ec8e8d4947d7f7bc in Lithium Extraction and ac5ff017870ecf2c7987cba39f243b0399b8f106 in MEA Thermodynamics were authored at 17:18 before D-024 and remain quarantined, non-admitted evidence. MEA Absorption Column retained its pre-existing dirty user work untouched.

preconditions: Doctrine revision 9 and D-024 authorized package authority to cut over with the named applications quarantined.
All accepted support branches were merged without history rewrite before repository retirement.
The downloaded Release asset matched the accepted candidate hash before the no-install transaction.
No package installation occurred after retiring the old repositories and entering the artifact transaction.
expected_postconditions: ePC-SAFT/ePC-SAFT-engine is the sole active runtime repository.
The epcsaft Release wheel at the recorded source commit and SHA-256 is the sole active runtime artifact.
The separate Equilibrium and Regression repositories and distributions remain retired without compatibility aliases.
Data, Validation, Lab, and the organization profile point to the completed Engine topology.
The three quarantined applications remain unsupported until separately migrated and admitted.
record.retry: No cutover retry is pending. Future artifact replacement or consumer admission requires a new exact subject and receipt.
stop_conditions: Engine repository ID, release source commit, or wheel hash differs from this receipt.
More than one ePC-SAFT runtime distribution becomes active.
A retired repository or compatibility import is reintroduced without a new doctrine decision.
A quarantined application is represented as admitted before its separate migration passes.
record.reversibility: Archived repositories can be unarchived for a separately authorized recovery. Active artifact bytes are immutable and replacement requires a new receipt. The former EOS namespace must not be reused or renamed back after authority acceptance because that would invalidate the durable redirect and current authority record.
irreversible_effects: The public repository rename and v0.2.0.dev0 Release are durable historical events.
The completed Governance receipt makes Engine the sole runtime authority and retires the split-package identities.
